verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer docs say the AI can delegate work to parallel sub-agents with the delegate_task tool, and that each sub-agent is a full chat with tool access. A separate use-case page describes running parallel agents, one per worktree and workspace, all supervised from a single browser tab. Together these directly deliver splitting and parallelizing real work across agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that sub-agent delegation works in practice, documentation of how sub-agent results are coordinated and merged, and any agent-to-agent protocol support.
